2608.13317.title: StateBridge: Training-free Hidden-state Alignment for Latent Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
2608.13317.paper_summary: Large language model based multi-agent systems usually communicate in text, i.e., using discrete tokens. However, text introduces a discrete bottleneck. Converting the sender's continuous hidden states into discrete tokens discards information that token identities alone cannot capture. Recent work proposes latent communication as an alternative, where agents transmit hidden representations directly without converting them to text. However, existing latent methods either inject working memory layer by layer across the transformers, or require trained projectors that limit portability. We propose StateBridge, a training-free latent communication approach that aligns the sender's final-layer hidden states to the receiver's input space via a closed-form orthogonal transformation. Lightweight norm calibration and vocabulary anchoring ensure compatibility with the pretrained input distribution. The aligned states are prepended to the input of the receiver agent as a continuous prefix. We evaluate StateBridge on math reasoning, code generation, and question answering with four models from two families. StateBridge achieves the best or tied-best score on 22 out of 26 model-task pairs, consistently outperforming the strongest baseline.
2608.13317.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型基礎的多代理系統通常以文本進行通信，即使用離散的標記。<lb/>然而，文本引入了一個離散的瓶頸。<lb/>將發送者的連續隱藏狀態轉換為離散標記會丟失那些僅靠標記身份無法捕捉的信息。<lb/>最近的研究提出了潛在通信作為一種替代方案，代理直接傳輸隱藏表示，而不將其轉換為文本。<lb/>然而，現有的潛在方法要麼在Transformer中逐層注入工作記憶，要麼需要訓練過的投影器，這限制了可攜性。<lb/>我們提出了StateBridge，一種無需訓練的潛在通信方法，通過封閉形式的正交變換將發送者的最終層隱藏狀態對齊到接收者的輸入空間。<lb/>輕量級的範數校準和詞彙錨定確保與預訓練輸入分佈的兼容性。<lb/>對齊的狀態作為連續前綴附加到接收者代理的輸入中。<lb/>我們在數學推理、代碼生成和問題回答上評估了StateBridge，使用來自兩個家族的四個模型。<lb/>StateBridge在26個模型-任務對中的22個上達到了最佳或並列最佳的分數，始終超越最強的基線。
